title: Argentina intensifies campaign against Falklands oil companies
english: The Argentine government is escalating its efforts to challenge oil exploration near the Falkland Islands by launching new legal actions against companies involved. President Javier Milei is also pursuing stricter legislative sanctions against these businesses as part of a renewed push to reassert Argentina's sovereignty over the territory. This campaign has intensified amid signals from U.S. leadership suggesting a potential shift in international support regarding the long-standing dispute between Argentina and the United Kingdom.

Preezidaanti Haaviyeer Miileyi naannoo kana irratti aangoo Arjantiinaa mirkaneessuuf jecha, dhaabbilee qorannoo kana irratti adabbii cimaa buusuuf qophaa'aa jiru. title: Republican congressman calls to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
english: Republican Congressman Thomas Massie has introduced a resolution to impeach Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, accusing him of conducting unauthorized military actions against Iran and ignoring civilian casualties. Massie argues that Hegseth has violated constitutional limits on military force and disregarded international laws governing conflict. Although the proposal could come to a vote soon, it is unlikely to pass given the Republican majority in the House and the Pentagon's continued support for the Secretary.

oromo: Miseensi Kongirasii Republiikii Toomaas Maassii, Ministira ittisaa Piit Heegseth irratti himata himannaa dhiyeessaniiru. Maassiin akka jedhanitti, ministirichi daangaa heera mootummaa cabsuufi seera waraana idil-addunyaa tuffachuun aangoo isaa sirritti hin fayyadamne. Haa ta'u malee, yaanni himannaa kun yeroo dhiyootti sagaleen irratti kennamuu danda'us, miseensonni mana maree irra caalaan isaanii mootummaa irra waan jiraniifi Pentagooniis ministiricha waan deggeruuf, himanni kun milkaa'uun isaa shakkisiisaa dha.

title: Ed Sheeran blames US tour promoter for dropping Macklemore
english: Pop star Ed Sheeran clarified that he did not personally remove rapper Macklemore from his US tour, but instead faced pressure from venue owners and promoters after Macklemore expressed support for Palestine. Stadium owners, including Robert Kraft, threatened to cancel performances unless the rapper was excluded, leading Sheeran to remove him to save the tour. In response to the decision, several other artists have decided to withdraw from Sheeran's tour in solidarity with Macklemore.

oromo: Sirbituu Ed Sheeran, raapparii Macklemore'n kan tour isaa irraa ari'ate fedhii isaatiin osoo hin taane, Macklemore waa'ee Falasxiin ergaa deggeruu erguusaa booda dhiibbaa qindeesitootaafi abbootii iddoo qophiirra gahuun akka ta'e ibseera. Abbootiin iddoo qophii, keessumaa Robert Kraft, Macklemore yoo hin ari'amin tour-ichi akka dhaabatu waan doorsisaniif, Sheeran dirqamee isa ari'uuf murteesse. Murtee kana mormuun, artistoonni biroo hedduun walitti dhufeenya Macklemore waliin qaban ibsuun tour Sheeran irraa of duuba deebi'aniiru.

title: Why is the far-right embracing crypto?
english: Far-right political groups and activists are increasingly using cryptocurrencies to secure funding and evade traditional financial oversight. This trend reflects a growing alliance between digital assets and conservative movements seeking alternative economic platforms. Experts suggest this strategy allows these groups to maintain financial independence and bypass government restrictions.

oromo: Gareewwan siyaasaa fi sochii mirga-dursaa (far-right) ta'an, maallaqa walitti qabachuu fi to'annoo baankii idilee irraa bilisa ta'uuf jecha maallaqa dijitaalaa ykn 'cryptocurrency' fayyadamuun babal'achaa jira. Kunis walitti dhufeenya haaraa teknolojii dijitaalaa fi gareewwan siyaasaa guddina diinagdee al-idilee barbaadan gidduutti uumame agarsiisa. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, mala kana fayyadamuun gareewwan kun maallaqaa isaanii to'annoo mootummaa irraa dhoksuu fi bilisummaa isaanii eeggachuu danda'u.

title: Vance says US war on Iran will enter 'much different phase' in coming months
english: US Vice President JD Vance stated that the initial stage of the conflict with Iran, focused on dismantling its nuclear and conventional military capabilities, is now complete. He announced that the war will transition into a new phase in the near future. The primary goal of this next stage is to prevent Iran from regaining its military strength while maintaining regional stability.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ፣ ከአይራን ጋር ሲካሄድ የነበረው የመጀመሪያው የጦርነት ምዕራፍ ማብቃቱን ገለጹ። ይህ የመጀመሪያ ምዕራፍ የአገሪቱን የኒውክሌር እና ወታደራዊ አቅም ለማዳከም ያለመ እንደነበር ተናግረዋል። በቀጣይ ወራት ጦርነቱ ወደ አዲስ ምዕራፍ እንደሚሸጋገር የገለጹት ቫንስ፣ ዓላማውም ኢራን እንደገና ወታደራዊ አቅሟን እንዳትገነባ በማድረግ ቀጠናዊ መረጋጋትን መጠበቅ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Itti aantuun pirezedaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance, waraanni Iran waliin geggeeffamaa ture sadarkaa jalqabaa irra akka gahe ibsan. Vance akka jedhanitti, waraanni kun gara fuulduraatti gara sadarkaa haarawaatti kan ce'u yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas Iran deebitee humna waraanaa akka hin ijaarre fi tasgabbii naannichaa eeguu dha.

title: US prepares $2.8bn weapons sale, funded by taxpayers, to Israel: Report
english: The Trump administration is planning a $2.8 billion weapons transfer to Israel, which includes 60,000 high-powered bombs funded by American taxpayers. This deal consists of heavy-duty munitions capable of causing significant destruction, sparking criticism from commentators regarding the necessity and ethics of such a large shipment. While the proposal has reached congressional committees, the administration has declined to provide details on the humanitarian implications of the sale.

title: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
english: Several supporting artists, including Finneas and Lukas Graham, have left Ed Sheeran's US tour following the promoter's decision to remove rapper Macklemore. Macklemore was cut from the lineup after expressing pro-Palestinian views during his performances. Ed Sheeran clarified that the decision was made by the promoters rather than himself and stated he wants to avoid public debates regarding the conflict.

oromo: Raapperi Maklemoor erga sagantaa Ed Sheeran irratti waa'ee Falastiin haasa'ee booda akka inni isaan biraa gaggeeffamu gochuu isaatiin, artistoonni biroo kunneenis duula kana keessaa of baasuuf murteessaniiru. title: South African president vows justice as more women's bodies found near Johannesburg
english: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa has promised a thorough investigation following the discovery of seven women's bodies near Johannesburg over the past two months. While police have not confirmed a serial killer, they are investigating the possibility of a coordinated group behind these violent crimes. The government is prioritizing these cases as public fear grows regarding the country's high rates of gender-based violence.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ሲሪል ራማፎሳ ባለፉት ሁለት ወራት በጆሃንስበርግ አካባቢ ሰባት የሴቶች አስከሬኖች መገኘታቸውን ተከትሎ አጥፊዎችን ለህግ ለማቅረብ ቃል ገብተዋል። ፖሊስ ግድያዎቹ በአንድ ነፍሰ ገዳይ የተፈጸሙ መሆናቸውን እስካሁን ባያረጋግጥም፣ ወንጀሉ በተደራጀ ቡድን ሊፈጸም እንደሚችል በመጠራጠር ምርመራ እያደረገ ነው። በሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የጾታ ጥቃት ስጋት በመኖሩ ምክንያት መንግስት ጉዳዩን በልዩ ትኩረት እየተከታተለው ይገኛል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Afrikaa Kibbaa Siiril Raamafoosaa ji'oota lamaan darban keessa magaalota Yoohannisbargii biratti reeffi dubartoota torbaa argamuu isaatiin walqabatee, yakka kana raawwattoota seeratti dhiheessuuf waadaa galaniiru. Poolisiin ajjeechaan kun nama tokkoon kan raawwatame ta'uu isaa ammaaf mirkaneessuu baatus, garee tokkoon raawwatame ta'uu akka danda'u shakkii qabanii qorannoo gaggeessaa jiru. Afrikaa Kibbaatti yakki saala irratti xiyyeeffatu baay'achuu isaan, mootummaan dhimma kana xiyyeeffannoo olaanaadhaan hordofaa jira.

title: Romanian shepards and farmers clash with police
english: Around 2,000 Romanian farmers and shepherds gathered in Bucharest to protest an EU-imposed ban on livestock exports caused by a sheep disease. The demonstration turned violent when protesters threw objects at police, who responded by using tear gas to regain control. Multiple people were injured and dozens were detained following the clashes, which were reportedly backed by local far-right political groups.
amharic: በሮማኒያ ቡካሬስት ወደ 2,000 የሚጠጉ አርብቶ አደሮች እና ገበሬዎች የሀገሪቱን የእንስሳት ኤክስፖርት እገዳ በመቃወም ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። በበሽታ ስርጭት ምክንያት የተጣለውን ይህንን እገዳ በመቃወም በተደረገው ተቃውሞ ወቅት ግጭት ተቀስቅሶ የፖሊስ አስለቃሽ ጋዝ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል። በዚህ ሁከት በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ ተቃውሞው በጽንፈኛ የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች የተደገፈ እንደነበር ተገልጿል።
oromo: Roomaaniyaatti qonnaan bultoonni fi tiksootni kuma lama ta'an, dhibee horii irratti mudateen walqabatee dhorkaalee ergaa horii biyya alaa irratti tures mormuuf magaala guddoo Bukarestitti hiriiran. Mormiin kun gara walitti bu'iinsaatti jijjiiramee poolisootni gazii imimmaan fiduu fayyadamuun hiriirtota bittimseera. Walitti bu'iinsa kanaan namootni hedduun miidhaniiru, kurnee hedduunis to'annoo jala oolaniiru; mormiin kunis gareewwan siyaasaa mirga-raree (far-right) ta'aniin deggeramaa akka ture himameera.

title: What makes these midterms so pivotal?
english: Journalists Krystal Ball and Jude Russo recently discussed the significance of the 2026 United States midterm elections on Al Jazeera. The conversation highlights how critical topics such as the economy, immigration, artificial intelligence, and foreign policy are influencing voter priorities. Additionally, the experts examine the deepening internal fractures within major political parties and the shifting dynamics of the modern media landscape.
amharic: ጋዜጠኞች ክሪስታል ቦል እና ጁድ ሩሶ በአልጀዚራ ጣቢያ ላይ ስለ አሜሪካ የ2026 የአጋማሽ ዘመን ምርጫ አስፈላጊነት ተወያይተዋል። ውይይቱ እንደ ኢኮኖሚ፣ ስደት፣ ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) እና የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ያሉ ጉዳዮች የመራጮችን ውሳኔ እንዴት እንደሚቀርጹ ያብራራል። በተጨማሪም ባለሙያዎቹ በዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ውስጥ ያሉትን የውስጥ ክፍፍሎች እና የሚዲያ ተቋማት እየተቀየሩ የመጡበትን ሁኔታ ይቃኛሉ።
oromo: Gaazexeessitoonni Kiriistaal Bool fi Juud Ruusoo, miidiyaa Al-Jazeera irratti waa'ee filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa Ameerikaa kan bara 2026 irratti mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun akkaataa dhimmoonni gurguddoon kan akka diinagdee, godaansaa, ogummaa maashinii (AI) fi siyaasa alaa murtoo filattootaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisan irratti xiyyeeffata. Kana malees, ogeeyyoonni kun gargar ba'iinsa paartilee siyaasaa gurguddoo keessa jiruufi jijjiirama ammayyaa keessa jiru irratti mari'ataniiru.

title: Why do some African leaders gamble with term limits?
english: Protests have erupted in the Democratic Republic of Congo following government plans to amend the constitution, which could potentially allow President Felix Tshisekedi to seek a third term in office. Critics view these legislative moves as a power grab that threatens to destabilize a nation already struggling with internal conflict and health crises. Experts are now debating the motives behind this bid and the potential negative impact it could have on regional stability.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ፌሊክስ ቺሴኬዲ ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ በስልጣን ለመቆየት የሚያስችላቸውን የሕገ መንግስት ማሻሻያ ለማድረግ ማቀዳቸውን ተከትሎ በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ተቃውሞዎች ተቀስቅሰዋል። ተቺዎች ይህ አካሄድ በግጭት እና በጤና ቀውሶች ለተጎዳችው ሀገር ስጋት የሚፈጥር የስልጣን ጥመኝነት ነው ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። ባለሙያዎችም ይህ የፕሬዚዳንቱ እርምጃ ሊያስከትል የሚችለውን የፖለቲካ ቀውስ እና በአካባቢው ሰላም ላይ የሚያመጣውን ተፅዕኖ እየመረመሩ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Feliks Chiisekedi yeroo sadaffaaf aangoo irratti turuuf akka isaaniif danda'amuuf sirreeffama seera bu'uuraa mootummaa taasisuuf karoorfataniin walqabatee, biyya Kongo keessatti mormiin guddaan ka'eera. Goleen biyyattii kanaan duras walitti bu'iinsaa fi dhibee fayyaatiin kan miidhamte yoo ta'u, tarkaanfiin kunis aangoo garmalee qabatanii turuuf yaalii taasifamuudha jechuun mormitoonni balaaleffatu. Hayyoonni waa'ee tarkaanfii kanaa fi miidhaa inni naannichatti fiduu danda'u irratti mari'achaa jiru.

title: Western intelligence warns of Iranian cyber threats targeting dissidents
english: Intelligence agencies from the U.S., U.K., and the Netherlands have issued a joint warning regarding Iranian state-linked hackers using specialized spyware called 'CHOSEN BRICK' to target dissidents living abroad. This malicious software is deployed through deceptive messages on platforms like WhatsApp and Telegram to steal private data and silence critics of the Iranian government. Authorities emphasize that these ongoing cyber operations are part of a broader effort by Iran's Ministry of Intelligence to monitor and intimidate its opposition globally.
amharic: የአሜሪካ፣ የእንግሊዝ እና የኔዘርላንድስ የስለላ ተቋማት ኢራን በውጭ አገር የሚኖሩ ተቃዋሚዎቿን ለመከታተል 'CHOSEN BRICK' በተባለ የሰላይ ሶፍትዌር እየተጠቀመች እንደሆነ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ሶፍትዌር በተለይ በዋትስአፕ እና በቴሌግራም መልእክቶች አማካይነት የግል መረጃዎችን ለመስረቅ እና በኢራን መንግሥት ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ትችቶችን ለማፈን ያገለግላል። ባለሥልጣናቱ እንደሚሉት፣ እነዚህ የሳይበር ጥቃቶች የኢራን የስለላ ሚኒስቴር ተቃዋሚዎቹን ለመቆጣጠር እና ለማስፈራራት ከሚጠቀምባቸው ስልቶች መካከል ዋነኞቹ ናቸው።
oromo: Qaamoleen basaastotaa Ameerikaa, UK fi Nezerlaandii, mootummaan Iraan biyyoota alaa keessa jiraattota isaa kanneen mormitoota ta'an hordofuuf 'CHOSEN BRICK' jedhamuun beekamuun akka fayyadamu akeekkachiisaniiru. Sooftiweerichi kun ergaawwan gowwoomsaa kanneen akka WhatsApp fi Telegram fayyadamuun odeeffannoo dhunfaa hatuufi mormitoota cal'isiisuuf gargaara. Qondaaltonni akka ibsanitti, gochaaleen biyyattii kun mootummaan Iraan mormitoota isaa addunyaa guutuu keessatti hordofuufi sodaachisuuf tarsiimoo itti fayyadamuudha.

title: Kennedy Center closes amid financial crisis and Trump name dispute
english: The Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. has officially closed its doors due to a severe financial crisis and ongoing building maintenance issues. The center's board, appointed by President Donald Trump, insists that the facility's future depends on adding the President's name to the structure, a move recently blocked by a federal judge. The court ruled that any such renaming requires explicit approval from Congress, leading to further tension between the board and the judiciary.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የሚገኘው የኬኔዲ ማዕከል ከባድ የገንዘብ ችግር እና የህንጻ ጥገና እጦት በመጥቀስ በሮቹን ዘግቷል። በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የተሾሙት የማዕከሉ አስተዳደር ቦርድ ህንጻው እንዲተርፍ የፕሬዝዳንቱ ስም በግንባታው ላይ መጻፍ አለበት ብለው ቢያምኑም፣ የፌዴራል ዳኛ ይህንን ውሳኔ ከልክለዋል። ዳኛው ማናቸውንም የስም ለውጥ ለማድረግ የኮንግረስ ፈቃድ እንደሚያስፈልግ በመወሰናቸው በቦርዱ እና በህግ አካላት መካከል ውዝግብ ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: ማዕከል ኬኔዲ kan Washington, D.C. keessatti argamu, rakkoo faayinaansii cimaa fi fedhii haaromsa irraa kan ka'e balbala isaa cufateera. Boordiin maaddiichaa kan Pirezidaant Doolaard Tiraampiin muudaman, haala kana fooyyessuuf maqaan Pirezidaantichaa iddoo sanatti barreeffamuu qaba jedhanii falmaa jiru. Haata'u malee, abbaan murtee federaalaa jijjiirraan maqaa kamiyyuu heeyyama koongeerasiin alatti akka hin raawwatamne murteessuun, walitti bu'iinsa boordichaa fi mana murtee gidduutti uumeera.

title: Badar Khan Suri blasts 'shallow' Trump administration at immigration hearing
english: Georgetown University scholar Badar Khan Suri has criticized the Trump administration’s attempts to deport him, labeling their legal arguments as baseless and politically motivated. Suri, an Indian citizen and legal U.S. resident married to an American, believes he is being targeted for his public advocacy regarding Palestinian rights. He maintains that the government's accusations of antisemitism are merely a strategy to justify his removal from the country.
amharic: የጆርጅታውን ዩኒቨርሲቲ ምሁር የሆኑት ባዳር ካን ሱሪ፣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከሀገር ለማስወጣት የሚያቀርበውን ክስ መሰረተ ቢስ እና ፖለቲካዊ ፍላጎት ያዘለ ነው ሲሉ አጣጥለዋል። የህንድ ዜግነት ያላቸው እና በአሜሪካ ህጋዊ የመኖሪያ ፈቃድ ያላቸው ሱሪ፣ ለፍልስጤማውያን መብት በመሟገታቸው ምክንያት ኢላማ እንደተደረጉ ይናገራሉ። መንግስት በከፈቱባቸው ክሶች አማካኝነት ፖለቲካዊ አጀንዳቸውን ለማራመድ እየሞከሩ ነው ሲሉም አስተያየታቸውን ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Hayyuun Yuunivarsitii Joorjiitaawunii Badar Khaan Surii, mootummaan Traamp isaan biyyattii irraa ari'uuf yaalii gochuutti jiru kun bu'uura kan hin qabneefi kaayyoo siyaasaa qofa kan qabu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Lammii Hindii fi jiraataa seeraa kan ta'an Surii, garaagarummaa mirga Paalastiyinotaaf falmuu isaaniitiin qofa akka xiyyeeffannoo mootummaa ta'an amanu. Mootummaan yakka isaan irratti dhiyeessu kun, ajandaa siyaasaa isaanii qofa galmaan ga'uuf kan itti fayyadaman ta'uu dubbatu.

title: Badar Khan Suri blasts 'shallow' Trump administration at immigration hearing
english: Georgetown scholar Badar Khan Suri is currently fighting deportation, criticizing the Trump administration's legal claims against him as baseless and politically motivated. Supporters and academic colleagues argue that the government is targeting him to harass his wife, who is from Gaza, due to her family background. Suri maintains that his legal troubles stem from his vocal support for Palestinian rights rather than any actual wrongdoing.
amharic: የጆርጅታውን ዩኒቨርሲቲ ምሁር ባዳር ካን ሱሪ በመንግስት የቀረበባቸውን የውጭ ሀገር ዜጋ የማስወጣት ክስ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር የሚያቀርባቸው መከራከሪያዎች መሰረተ ቢስ እና ፖለቲካዊ ፍላጎት ያላቸው መሆናቸውን ተናግረዋል። የሱሪ ደጋፊዎች እና የሥራ ባልደረቦች እንደሚሉት፣ መንግስት ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደው ከጋዛ የመጣችውን ባለቤታቸውን ለማንገላታት ነው። ሱሪ ችግሩ የተፈጠረው ለፍልስጤም መብቶች በመቆማቸው እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hayyuun Yuunivarsitii Joorjiitawn Baadaar Kaan Suurii, mootummaan Tiramp karaa seeraa biyyaa isa baasuuf yaaluu isaa balaaleffatee, himannaan kun bu'uura kan hin qabneefi kaayyoo siyaasaa qofa kan qabu ta'uu ibse. Deeggartoonniifi gahiin hojii isaa akka jedhanitti, mootummaan kana kan godhe haadha manaa isaa ishee Gaazaa irraa dhuftetti garmalee miidhuufi. Suuriin rakkoon kun kan isa mudate falmaa mirga Falastiiniif taasisaa jiruun wal qabatee akka ta'e dubbata.

title: Israeli strike on tents in Gaza kills two Palestinians, including a child
english: An Israeli airstrike targeting temporary shelters in Gaza's Al-Mawasi region resulted in the deaths of two individuals, among them an eight-year-old girl. At least 14 additional people sustained injuries during the incident. These tents were being used by displaced civilians seeking safety in the area.
amharic: በጋዛ አል-ማዋሲ አካባቢ በሚገኙ ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ላይ የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች ባደረሱት ጥቃት አንድ የ8 ዓመት ህፃን ልጅን ጨምሮ ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በዚህ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። እነዚህ መጠለያዎች ከቀያቸው የተፈናቀሉ ሰዎች መጠለያ ሆነው ያገለግሉ ነበር።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el naannoo Al-Mawasi kan Gazaatti iddoolee namoonni buqqa'an keessa jiraatan irratti xiyyaaraan haleellaa gaggeesseen, mucittii umriin ishee waggaa saddeet ta'e dabalatee namoonni lama ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni 14 ol ta'an miidhaniiru. Iddoon kun namoota buqqa'anii godoo keessa jiraachaa turan irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture.

title: Rubio, Omani foreign minister discuss Iranian attacks and Hormuz shipping
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio held talks with Oman's Foreign Minister to address rising tensions caused by Iranian aggression in the region. Rubio condemned Iran's recent attacks on commercial vessels and emphasized the American commitment to maintaining maritime security in the Strait of Hormuz. Additionally, he reaffirmed the US position that Iran must be prevented from developing nuclear weapons.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የኢራን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ለመወያየት ከኦማን አቻቸው ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ሩቢዮ የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጥቃት በማውገዝ፣ በአካባቢው የባህር ላይ ደህንነትን ለማስጠበቅ አሜሪካ ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። እንዲሁም ኢራን የኒውክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል አሜሪካ ያላትን ጠንካራ አቋም አስታውሰዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo, gochaa hammeenyaa Iraaniin naannichatti raawwatamaa jiru irratti mari'achuuf ministira dhimma alaa Omaan waliin walga'aniiru. Ruubiyoon weerara dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti raawwatamu balaaleffachuun, nageenya galaana Ormuz eeguuf Ameerikaan kutannoo qabaachuu ishee mirkaneessaniiru. Kana malees, Iraan meeshaa niwukilaaraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf Ameerikaan akka cimtee itti fufu ibsaniiru.

title: ‘Consequences of raising my voice’: Leqaa Kordia suffers fifth seizure since ICE detention
english: Palestinian activist Leqaa Kordia reports that she has experienced her fifth seizure since being released from a year-long detention by U.S. immigration authorities in March. Kordia, who had no history of seizures prior to her incarceration, believes the medical condition is a result of the trauma and inadequate care she faced while in custody. She continues to struggle with these ongoing health issues and the lasting impact of her imprisonment on her daily life.
amharic: የፍልስጤም አክቲቪስት ለቃ ኮርዲያ ከአንድ ዓመት እስር በኋላ በነፃነት ከተለቀቀች ወዲህ ለአምስተኛ ጊዜ የሚጥል በሽታ እንዳጋጠማት አስታውቃለች። ኮርዲያ ከእስሯ በፊት እንዲህ አይነት የጤና እክል እንዳልነበረባት በመግለጽ፣ የጤና እክሉ በእስር ቤት በቆየችበት ወቅት በደረሰባት ድብርት እና በቂ ህክምና ባለማግኘቷ እንደመጣ ታምናለች። እስካሁንም ድረስ ከዚህ የጤና ችግር እና ከእስር ቤቱ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ ጋር ትታገላለች።
oromo: Leqaa Kordia jedhamtuu fi falmituu mirgaa kan taate lammii Paalestaayinii, ji'a Bitootessaa waggaa tokko booda hidhaa godaantotaa keessaa erga baatee as yeroo shanaffaaf dhukkubbiin kukkuftee (seizure) akka ishee mudate ibsiteetti. Kordia hidhamuu ishee dura dhukkuba kana akka hin qabne kan himtu yoo ta'u, rakkinni fayyaa kun miidhaa qaamaa fi sammuu akkasumas walitti fufiinsa dhabachuu wal’aansa fayyaa isheen yeroo hidhaa keessa turte ishee mudate irraa kan dhufe akka ta'e amanti. Yeroo ammaa kana rakkoo fayyaa kanaa fi miidhaa sammuu hidhaan ishee irra ga'e waliin qabsoo gochaa jirti.

title: What weapon could the US have put into space?
english: The United States recently announced the deployment of a secretive space weapon, citing the need to defend its forces against potential adversaries. Experts suggest this hardware likely functions as an electronic jamming tool to disable enemy communications, though they have not ruled out more aggressive technologies designed to physically collide with or grapple other satellites. This development highlights an intensifying global competition, as world powers increasingly prioritize military dominance in space through advanced technology.
amharic: አሜሪካ የራሷን የጦር ኃይል ከጠላት ጥቃት ለመከላከል በሚል ምህዋር ውስጥ ሚስጥራዊ የጠፈር መሣሪያ ማሰማራቷን ይፋ አድርጋለች። የጠፈር ጉዳይ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ይህ መሣሪያ የጠላትን የመገናኛ ዘዴዎች የሚያስተጓጉል የኤሌክትሮኒክስ መሣሪያ ሊሆን ይችላል፤ ነገር ግን ሌሎች ሳተላይቶችን በአካል መግጨት ወይም መያዝ የሚችሉ አደገኛ ቴክኖሎጂዎች የመሆን እድልም አለው። ይህ ክስተት ሀያላን መንግሥታት በጠፈር ውስጥ የበላይነትን ለመቀዳጀት እያደረጉት ያለውን ከፍተኛ ውድድር በግልጽ ያሳያል።
oromo: Amerika humna ishee ittisuuf jechuun meeshaa waraanaa icciitii qabu gara hawaatti erguushee beeksisteetti. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, meeshaan kun quunnamtii diinaa addaan kutuuf kan gargaaru ta'uu mala; haa ta'u malee, satalaayitoota biroo rukutuun ykn qabachuun mancaasuu kan danda'an meeshaalee gurguddoo ta'uu irrattis shakkii qabu. Tarkaanfiin kun hawaa keessatti biyyoonni gurguddoon dorgommii waraanaa akka daran hammaataa jiran kan argisiisuudha.

title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
english: Two sailors are missing and 23 have been rescued after a Panama-flagged oil tanker caught fire following an attack in the Strait of Hormuz. While Iran claims the vessel hit naval mines, the US military reports that the ship was struck by a drone. This incident is part of a series of maritime attacks in the region that have caused multiple casualties since late February.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በተፈጸመ ጥቃት የፓናማ ባንዲራ የነበረው የነዳጅ መርከብ በእሳት መጋየቱን ተከትሎ ሁለት መርከበኞች የት እንደደረሱ ሳይታወቅ ቀርተዋል፤ 23 መርከበኞች ደግሞ በሕይወት መትረፋቸውን የኦማን ባለሥልጣናት አስታውቀዋል። ኢራን መርከቧ የባህር ማዕድን እንደገጠማት ብትገልጽም፣ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ግን ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በድሮን እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። ይህ ክስተት ከየካቲት ወር መጨረሻ ጀምሮ በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣው የባህር ላይ ጥቃት አካል ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ሰዎች ለህልፈት እንዲዳረጉ አድርጓል።
oromo: Hormuz Strait keessatti doonii boba'aa kan dursee biyya Panamaa ture irratti haleellaa erga raawwatamee booda ibidde ka'een namoonni lama badee jiru, 23 ammoo lubbuun oolanii jiru. Iran dooniin sun miinii galaanaatti bu'uu isaa kan ibsitu ta'us, waraanni Ameerikaa garuu haleellaan sun dorooneedhaan kan raawwatame ta'uu beeksisanii jiru. Miidhaan kun kanneen ganna kana keessa naannichatti raawwatamaa jiran keessaa tokko yoo ta'u, lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafatee jira.

title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
english: A report from the Pentagon’s inspector general confirms that the conflict with Iran has caused significant ammunition shortages and production delays for the US military. This finding contradicts claims by President Trump, who has insisted that American weapons supplies remain plentiful. While the administration dismisses these reports as false, the watchdog indicates that billions of dollars in spending and heavy usage of missile defense systems have strained the country's military inventory.
amharic: የፔንታጎን ዋና ኢንስፔክተር ያወጡት ሪፖርት እንደሚያሳየው ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ጦርነት በአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ መሣሪያዎች አቅርቦት ላይ እጥረት እና የልዩነት ችግር ፈጥሯል። ይህ ግኝት የአሜሪካ የጦር መሣሪያ ክምችት በቂ ነው የሚሉትን የፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕን መግለጫዎች ይቃረናል። የአሜሪካ መንግሥት መረጃዎቹን ቢያስተባብልም፣ የገለልተኛ ኦዲተሩ ሪፖርት ከፍተኛ ወጪ መደረጉና የሚሳኤል መከላከያ ሥርዓቶች በብዛት ጥቅም ላይ መዋላቸው ለዚህ እጥረት መፈጠር ምክንያት መሆናቸውን ያረጋግጣል።
oromo: Gabaasni qorataa olaanaa Pentaagonii akka ibsetti, waraanni Iran waliin taasifamu kun gahaa ta'uu dhabuu meeshaalee waraanaa fi rakkoo dhiyeessii Amerikaa keessatti uumeera. Qorannoon kun himannaa Preezdaant Traamp kanneen meeshaaleen waraanaa biyyattii gahaa dha jedhan mormuun kan ka'e dha. Mootummaan gabaasa kana dhugaa miti jedhee haaluus, ogeeyyiin dhimmi kana hordofan garuu baasii guddaa fi fayyadama meeshaalee ittisa xiyyaaraa irraa kan ka'e kuusaan meeshaalee waraanaa Amerikaa hir'achuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Police crack down on protests against constitutional change in DR Congo
english: Protests broke out across the Democratic Republic of the Congo as citizens rallied against President Felix Tshisekedi’s proposed constitutional changes that could permit a third term in office. Police used tear gas and arrested several activists to suppress the demonstrations organized by opposition groups in cities like Kinshasa and Lubumbashi. This political tension comes as the nation continues to struggle with ongoing regional conflicts and a challenging health crisis.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ፌሊክስ ቺሴኬዲ ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ በስልጣን ላይ እንዲቆዩ የሚያስችለውን የህገ-መንግስት ማሻሻያ በመቃወም በመላው ኮንጎ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ተካሂደዋል። የፖሊስ ሰራዊት በኪንሻሳ እና በሉቡምባሺ ከተሞች የተነሱትን ሰልፎች ለመበተን አስለቃሽ ጋዝ የተጠቀሙ ሲሆን በርካታ ተቃዋሚዎችንም በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ሀገሪቱ ቀድሞውኑ ካለባት የውስጥ ግጭት እና የጤና ቀውስ በተጨማሪ ይህ የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት ተጨማሪ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Felix Tshisekedi yeroo sadaffaaf aangoo irratti akka turan kan taasisu jijjiirama seera bu’uuraa mormuun, biyyattii keessatti hiriirri mormii bal’aan geggeeffameera. Poolisiin magaalonni Kinshasaa fi Lubumbashi keessatti hiriira kana dhaabuuf gaazii imimmaansu fayyadamuun namoota baay’ee hidheera. Rakkoolee nageenyaa fi dhukkuba biyyattii keessa jiran cinaatti, mormiin kun mootummaa irratti dhiibbaa dabalataa uumeera.

title: More than 100,000 displaced as they flee violence in Yemen: UN
english: The United Nations reports that over 100,000 people have been displaced due to intensifying conflict between Houthi rebels and the Yemeni government. Many families are fleeing to Djibouti by crossing the dangerous Bab al-Mandeb strait, while those remaining face severe shortages of food, water, and shelter. The UN is calling for $14 million in urgent funding to provide humanitarian assistance to the displaced families and struggling host communities.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በሁቲ አማፂያን እና በየመን መንግስት መካከል እየተባባሰ በመጣው ግጭት ምክንያት ከ100,000 በላይ ሰዎች መፈናቀላቸውን አስታውቋል። ብዙ ቤተሰቦች አደገኛውን የባብ አል-ማንደብ ባህር ሰላጤ በማቋረጥ ወደ ጅቡቲ እየሸሹ ሲሆን፣ በየመን የቀሩት ደግሞ የምግብ፣ የውሃ እና የመጠለያ እጥረት ገጥሟቸዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ለተፈናቃዮች እና ለተጎጂ ማህበረሰቦች አስቸኳይ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ለማቅረብ 14 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ድጋፍ እንደሚፈልግ ገልጿል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, loltoota Huutii fi mootummaa Yemen gidduutti walitti bu’iinsi hammaachuu isaa hordofee namoonni 100,000 ol ta’an buqqa’aniiru. Maatiin hedduun daandii galaana Baab al-Mandeb kan yaaddisaa ta’e qaxxaamuruun gara Jibuutitti baqachaa jiru; warri achi hafan ammoo dhabama nyaataa, bishaanii fi mana jireenyaatiin miidhamaa jiru. Dhaabbatichi maatii buqqa’anif gargaarsa namoomaa ariifachiisaa ta’e kennuuf qarshii miiliyoona 14 akka barbaadu beeksiseera.

title: How an Israeli cell orchestrated an anti-Qatar campaign
english: A report by Haaretz reveals that a group of around 30 Israeli influencers and former officials launched a secret campaign against Qatar following the October 7 attacks. The initiative aimed to pressure Qatar into using its influence with Hamas to help secure the release of hostages held in Gaza. While described as a civilian effort, experts suggest the operation likely had state backing and was intended to sway international public opinion.

oromo: Gabaasni Haaretz akka ibsutti, haleellaa Sadaasa 7 booda namoonni Israa'el 30 ta'an fi ogeeyyonni kanaan duraa qindoominaan Qatar irratti duula icciitii tokko geggeessaniiru. Duulli kun Qatar dhiibbaa Hamas irratti qabdu fayyadamuun hidhamtoonni akka gadhiifaman dirqisiisuuf kan kaayyeffate ture. Duulli kun sochii namoota dhuunfaa ta'us, ogeeyyonni garuu duulli kun deeggarsa mootummaa kan qabu fi yaada uummata addunyaa jijjiiruuf kan qophaa'e ta'uu dubbatu.

title: Can China play peacemaker as Iran’s foreign minister heads to Beijing?
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is visiting Beijing to meet with his Chinese counterpart as tensions continue to rise following the US-Israel war on Iran. While Chinese President Xi Jinping is advocating for regional stability and encouraging BRICS nations to help mediate, China remains cautious about becoming directly involved in the conflict. Experts note that although Beijing seeks to protect its economic and energy interests, it typically avoids deep entanglement in foreign diplomatic disputes.

title: Election in Philippines’ Bangsamoro region ends in hung parliament
english: The first parliamentary election in the Philippines' Bangsamoro region has concluded without a single party winning a majority, leading to a hung parliament. Two rival factions that split from the Moro Islamic Liberation Front are now forced to negotiate a coalition to govern the region. While some residents expressed concerns about potential instability, leaders from both sides have indicated they are willing to work together to form a government.

english: Robert Kraft is a prominent American billionaire best known as the owner of the NFL's New England Patriots. Beyond sports, he is recognized for his active involvement in philanthropy and various business ventures.

title: What are ‘space weapons’, which US says it has deployed into orbit?
english: The United States Air Force recently confirmed that it has deployed defensive space weapons into Earth's orbit to protect its military assets from rivals like China and Russia. While officials provided little detail on the specific technology or quantity, they described these tools as essential for maintaining space superiority. Experts warn that this move signals a major escalation in the militarization of space, potentially putting critical global infrastructure like GPS and communications at risk.

title: Trump says AI safety fears a 'hoax' as he rejects calls for greater safeguards
english: Donald Trump has dismissed concerns regarding the safety of artificial intelligence, labeling such warnings as a hoax and rejecting calls for stricter industry regulations. He argued that instead of government guardrails, strong leadership is the key to mastering the technology to avoid falling behind global competitors like China. This stance counters recent suggestions from tech industry leaders who believe mandatory safety features, such as emergency shut-off switches, are necessary to mitigate potential risks.

title: What to watch in the US’s Delaware primary elections
english: Delaware is holding the final state primary of the season, which will determine the candidates for the upcoming November midterm elections. While voters are selecting candidates for several offices including Senate and the House of Representatives, the state is expected to remain a strong Democratic stronghold.

title: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys makes Emmy Awards history with double win
english: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys has achieved a historic milestone by becoming the first person to win two lead acting Emmy Awards in a single night. He received these honors for his performances in the comedy Widow's Bay and the thriller The Beast In Me. During his speeches, he proudly represented Wales and expressed his gratitude toward those who helped him throughout his acting career.

title: Nato jets down drone that entered Lithuanian airspace
english: NATO fighter jets successfully intercepted and destroyed an unidentified drone that crossed into Lithuanian airspace from Belarus early Tuesday. Lithuanian officials confirmed the incident near the city of Kaunas, emphasizing that the quick response demonstrates the region's heightened security readiness. While the drone's origin remains under investigation, the event follows a trend of increasing aerial incursions near NATO borders since the conflict in Ukraine began.

title: US confirms for first time it has deployed space weapons
english: The United States has officially acknowledged for the first time that it has deployed offensive space weapons into orbit to protect its interests. Air Force officials stated these capabilities are essential to counter growing threats from nations like China and Russia that aim to disrupt American satellite networks. While specific details about the technology remain classified, the mission is part of a broader strategy to defend space assets and maintain military dominance.

title: Emmy winners 2026: ‘Widow’s Bay’ and ‘The Pitt’ dominate
english: The 78th Emmy Awards saw major victories for the comedy-horror series 'Widow's Bay' and the medical drama 'The Pitt,' both of which secured top honors. Jean Smart made history by winning lead comedy actress for every season of 'Hacks,' while Noah Wyle celebrated his second consecutive win for best lead drama actor. Additionally, Matthew Rhys set a record as the first individual to receive two lead acting awards during a single ceremony.
amharic: በ78ኛው የኤሚ የቴሌቪዥን ሽልማት ሥነ-ሥርዓት ላይ 'ዊዶውስ ቤይ' የተሰኘው የኮሜዲ አስፈሪ ተከታታይ እና 'ዘ ፒት' የተሰኘው የህክምና ድራማ ዋና ዋና ሽልማቶችን አሸንፈዋል። ጂን ስማርት በ'ሃክስ' የቴሌቪዥን ፕሮግራም ለእያንዳንዱ የውድድር ዘመን የዋና ተዋናይነት ሽልማትን በማግኘት ታሪክ ስትሠራ፣ ኖህ ዋይል ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ ተከታታይ የዋና ድራማ ተዋናይ ሽልማት አሸናፊ ሆኗል። በተጨማሪም ማቲው ሪስ በአንድ የሽልማት ሥነ-ሥርዓት ላይ ሁለት የዋና ተዋናይነት ሽልማቶችን በመውሰድ አዲስ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግቧል።

Jean Smart sagantaa 'Hacks' keessatti yeroo hunda badhaasa sagantaa sanaa waan injifatteef seenaa hojjetteetti, akkasumas Noah Wyle badhaasa isaa isa lammaffaa walitti aansuun badhaafameera. Kana malees, Matthew Rhys sagantaa tokko irratti badhaasa walitti aansuun lama injifachuudhaan rekordii haaraa galmeesseera.

title: Millions line up for ‘sacred henna’ at Indian temple
english: Massive crowds gathered at the Moti Dungri Ganesh Temple in India to receive sacred henna. Many believe that applying this blessed henna will help unmarried individuals find a life partner within a year. Temple officials distributed approximately 3,500 kilograms of the henna during the three-hour event.

title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump mail ballot restrictions ahead of midterms
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has declined to reinstate strict new mail-in voting requirements backed by President Trump. The court upheld a lower judge's decision to block the rules, noting that the administration was unlikely to win the legal argument on the merits. This decision ensures that mail-in ballots will continue to be processed under existing standards for the upcoming midterm elections.

title: Trump administration suffers double legal setback over immigration policy
english: The Trump administration recently faced two major legal challenges regarding its immigration policies. A federal judge blocked new rules that would have placed strict time limits on visas for international students, exchange visitors, and journalists. Additionally, a coalition of states and organizations launched lawsuits to stop a regulation that would allow officials to deny green cards to immigrants who utilize public benefits.

Kana malees, gamtaan giddu-galeessotaa fi dhaabbileen biroo seerii suuqiin (green card) godaantota fayyadamtoota tajaajila mootummaa ta’an akka hin arganne dhoorku akka dhaabatuuf himata seeraa dhiyeessaniiru.

title: Sweden election is too close to call as far right loses ground
english: The recent Swedish election remains too close to call, with the centre-left opposition bloc holding a razor-thin lead over the governing coalition. Support for the far-right Sweden Democrats has surprisingly declined for the first time in over a decade, though they remain a powerful political influence. Final results are expected by Wednesday once all overseas and early votes are tallied, which will determine who forms the next government.

title: Iran war live: CENTCOM disputes IRGC claim supertanker struck by Hormuz nav
english: The U.S. Central Command has rejected Iran’s assertion that a Panamanian oil tanker was damaged by a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz. Instead, American officials state the ship was targeted by an Iranian missile last month and a drone attack this past weekend. Meanwhile, President Trump has indicated that while Iran may be seeking negotiations, he remains undecided on whether to pursue a deal.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ (CENTCOM) የኢራን ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብ ላይ የደረሰው ጉዳት በባህር ማዕድን ምክንያት ነው የሚለውን መግለጫ ውድቅ አድርጓል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት እንደሚሉት መርከቧ ባለፈው ወር በኢራን ሚሳኤል የተመታች ሲሆን፣ ባለፈው ቅዳሜና እሁድ ደግሞ በድሮን ጥቃት ደርሶባታል። በሌላ በኩል ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ኢራን ድርድር እንደምትፈልግ ቢጠቅሱም፣ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያለው የድርድር ሂደት እርግጠኛ አለመሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ajajni giddu-galeessa Ameerikaa (CENTCOM) himata Iran kan markabni fe'umsa boba'aa tokko bishaan Hormuz keessatti minedii galaanaa kanaan miidhame jedhu dhugaa miti jedhee haale. title: Landowners in Texas ask court to stop Trump border wall
english: A group of Texas landowners, ranchers, and organizations has filed a lawsuit to halt the construction of a border wall in the Big Bend region. The plaintiffs argue that the project is unnecessary and unfairly ignores local opposition, as well as the cultural and environmental significance of their land. This legal challenge is part of a wider trend of resistance against the Trump administration's massive border infrastructure project across several states.

title: Israeli forces shoot dead Lebanese citizen
english: A Lebanese individual was killed on Sunday following an artillery strike by Israeli forces in the town of Baraachit. State news sources confirmed the incident took place during the shelling. This event marks another escalation in the ongoing regional tensions.

title: Saudi-led coalition says over a dozen civilians wounded in Houthi attacks on kingdom
english: Thirteen civilians sustained injuries following Houthi militant strikes on multiple Saudi Arabian cities this past Monday. The attacks resulted in damage to several private homes and vehicles after targeting local infrastructure. In response, the Saudi-led coalition condemned the aggression and promised to take firm action against the group.

title: Iranian official says no talks until Tehran’s conditions are met
english: A senior Iranian official has dismissed recent overtures from US President Donald Trump, labeling his changing stances as confusing and inconsistent. The official emphasized that Tehran remains firm in its refusal to engage in negotiations unless its specific demands are fully satisfied. He further noted that the regional situation regarding oil and maritime routes has evolved, suggesting that temporary efforts to manage the crisis will not resolve the underlying tensions.

title: Attack on Saudi Arabian pipeline may cut four percent of world's oil supply
english: A drone attack on a major Saudi Arabian pipeline is expected to disrupt four percent of global oil supplies for over a month. This incident, combined with Houthi control over a vital Red Sea shipping route, has caused international oil prices to spike significantly. Consumers are likely to face higher costs for fuel and related products as a result of these disruptions.

oromo: Itti baaburaa (drone) boorii boba'aa guddaa Saudii Arabaa irratti raawwatameen, dhiyeessiin boba'aa addunyaa harka afur irra miidhaan ga'uu danda'a. Suphuun miidhaa kanaas torban jaha ol kan fudhatu ta'uun ibsameera. Haalli kun fi to'annoo gareen Huutii daandii galaana diimaa irratti qaban, gatiin boba'aa addunyaa akka ol ka'u taasiseera, kunis gatii boba'aa fi meeshaalee boba'aa irraa argaman irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera.

title: Saudi East-West pipeline expected to resume operations soon, US energy chief says
english: The U.S. Energy Secretary announced that Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline will restart shortly after being closed due to a recent attack. Officials noted that while such strikes on energy infrastructure are a recurring issue, Saudi authorities have consistently demonstrated the ability to repair and restore operations quickly. The pipeline is expected to be fully functional again in the near future.

oromo: Ministirri anniisaa Ameerikaa akka ibsetti, boombiin boba'aa bahaa fi dhihaa kan Sa'udii Arabaa erga haleellaa irratti raawwatamee booda cufamee ture yeroo dhiyootti deebi'ee hojii akka jalqabu beekameera. Haleellaan bu'uuraalee misooma anniisaa irratti raawwatamu kun kan barame ta'us, mootummaan Sa'udii miidhaa ga'e ariitiin suphuun hojii itti fufsiisuuf dandeettii akka qabu ibsameera. Boombiin kunis dhiyootti deebi'ee hojii akka jalqabu eegama.

title: Israeli attack targets Gaza displacement camp
english: An Israeli military strike hit a displacement camp in Gaza City, resulting in at least one death and multiple injuries. Witnesses reported that the attack specifically targeted areas where displaced people were staying in tents. This incident is part of ongoing violence occurring throughout the Gaza Strip.

oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel qubata namoota buqqa'anii magaalaa Gaazaa keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwateera. Jiraattonni akka jedhanitti, haleellaan kun kan qajeele namoonni buqqa'aan kun dunkaana keessatti qubatanii jiran irratti ture.

title: US repeals rules limiting greenhouse gas emissions by power plants
english: The U.S. government has officially removed environmental regulations that previously restricted greenhouse gas emissions from coal and gas power plants. Officials claim this decision will reduce industry costs by over $300 billion and boost energy infrastructure development. However, environmental advocates strongly oppose the move, warning that it will damage public health and accelerate the negative impacts of climate change.

oromo: Mootummaan US seera mana humnaa (power plants) kanneen qilleensa faaluu irratti daangaa kaa'aa turan guutummaatti haqeera. Haata'u malee, dhaabbileen nageenya naannoo fi fayyaa irratti hojjetan tarkaanfichi fayyaa hawaasaa irratti miidhaa akka geessisuu fi jijjiirama qilleensaa kan babal'isu ta'uu ibsuun mormaa jiru.

title: Macklemore cut from Ed Sheeran tour for pro-Palestine stance
english: Rapper Macklemore claims he was removed from Ed Sheeran's US tour due to his vocal support for Palestine. He alleges that billionaire Robert Kraft influenced this decision, following previous criticism from other artists regarding his political stance. This incident highlights the ongoing tensions and industry pressures surrounding public figures who speak out on the Israel-Palestine conflict.
amharic: ራፐር ማክለሞር በፓለስቲን ላይ ባለው አቋም ምክንያት ከኤድ ሺራን የአሜሪካ ጉብኝት እንደተወገደ ገልጿል። አርቲስቱ ይህ ውሳኔ እንዲወሰድ ቢሊየነሩ ሮበርት ክራፍት በኤድ ሺራን ላይ ጫና እንደፈጠሩበት ይናገራል። ይህ ክስተት በኢስራኤል እና ፓለስቲን ግጭት ላይ የራሳቸውን አመለካከት በሚያንጸባርቁ ታዋቂ ሰዎች ላይ በሙዚቃው ኢንዱስትሪ ውስጥ ያለውን ጫና ያሳያል።

title: ‘Columbia did not care’: Mahmoud Khalil files discrimination lawsuit
english: Mahmoud Khalil, a former Columbia University student and pro-Palestinian activist, has initiated a lawsuit against the institution and a university dean. He claims that the school engaged in systemic racism and failed to protect Palestinian students from discrimination. The legal action seeks to hold the university accountable for its alleged indifference toward the experiences and safety of these students.

Himatni kun yunivarsitichi barattoota kanaaf qabu akkaataa itti gadi aantummaa agarsiise irratti gaafatama akka fudhatu gaafata.

title: Why talks in Oman between Iran and Gulf Arab states were postponed
english: Diplomatic discussions between Iran and Gulf Arab countries in Oman have been delayed, creating a setback for potential regional peace efforts. Experts are currently analyzing the reasons behind this postponement and its impact on ongoing tensions. The delay highlights the fragile nature of current geopolitical negotiations in the Middle East.

oromo: Mariin dippilomaasii kan biyyoota gaalafii Iiraan gidduutti Omaani keessatti taasifamuuf karoorfame ture haala hin baramneen dheerachuu isaa hordofee, carraan nageenya naannichaa fiduu danda'u miidhamuu isaa ibsameera. Dheerinni kunis haalli siyaasaa giddugaleessa bahaa amma iyyuu kan hin amanamne fi rakkisaa ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Jerusalem Daily: A new report on the erosion of Palestinian life
english: A recent report by the organization B’Tselem highlights a deliberate and ongoing decline in the quality of Palestinian life. The findings detail severe issues, including threats by Israeli authorities to strip film directors of their citizenship, frequent attacks on Palestinian agricultural lands by settlers, and a worsening humanitarian situation in Gaza. These developments suggest a systematic escalation of challenges facing Palestinians under the current occupation.

title: India to supply Nepal electricity after floods wrecked hydropower projects
english: India is providing Nepal with 654 megawatts of electricity daily until the end of the year to address power shortages caused by last month's catastrophic glacial floods. These floods destroyed several hydropower plants that previously supplied almost all of Nepal’s energy, leaving the country heavily dependent on imports. The disaster, which also resulted in significant loss of life and displacement, highlights the growing threat of climate change to the region's infrastructure.

title: Carney pitches Canada to global investors amid US trade war
english: Prime Minister Mark Carney is hosting a major investment summit in Toronto to attract global capital to Canada amid intense trade tensions with the United States. While Canada previously relied on its economic proximity to the U.S., the government is now seeking to diversify by securing $1 trillion in new investments across sectors like technology, infrastructure, and mining. This strategic push comes as both nations impose significant tariffs on each other following the collapse of recent trade negotiations.

oromo: Muummee Ministiraa Maark Kaarnii dhiibbaa daldalaan Yunaayitid Isteetis waliin jiru keessatti, invastimantii addunyaa gara Kaanaadaatti harkisuuf Toroontotti walgahii guddaa gaggeessaa jiru. title: EU states to raise game as Arctic becomes strategic geopolitical frontier
english: European Union nations have committed to increasing their investment and influence in the Arctic as the region becomes a crucial center for global power dynamics. With melting ice making the area more accessible for resources and shipping, leaders view the territory as a strategic frontier that requires a stronger security presence. The bloc specifically aims to counter growing challenges from Russia, China, and the United States to protect its long-term economic and regional interests.

title: Syria fuel price hikes test public patience with economic recovery
english: Syrians have taken to the streets to protest a sudden and significant increase in fuel prices, which has worsened the ongoing cost-of-living crisis. Although the government claims these price hikes are temporary and driven by regional instability, citizens remain frustrated that their economic situation has not improved since the end of the previous regime. Lawmakers have begun questioning energy officials as public anger continues to grow over the struggle to afford basic necessities.

title: Rights group accuses Israel of dismantling 'foundations of Palestinian existence' in West Bank
english: The Israeli human rights organization B'Tselem released a report claiming that current Israeli policies in the West Bank are intentionally destroying Palestinian society. The report highlights five key tactics, including systemic violence, economic pressure, and the forced displacement of small communities. According to the group, these coordinated actions aim to systematically dismantle the core foundations necessary for Palestinians to live together as a people.

title: Universities slam Belgian refusal to evacuate Gaza students
english: Major Belgian universities have criticized the government for blocking the evacuation of 13 Palestinian scholarship students from Gaza. University leaders argue that the administration is unfairly using these students as leverage in political negotiations regarding migration policies. Despite efforts by some officials to assist, the government remains divided and has failed to show the political resolve needed to bring the students to safety.

title: Attack on Saudi Arabian pipeline may cut four percent of world's oil supply
english: A drone strike on Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline has caused significant damage, potentially removing four percent of the world's oil supply from the market for over a month. This disruption has driven global oil prices upward, worsening existing economic concerns regarding inflation. The attack is being linked to regional tensions involving Iran-aligned militias, highlighting the ongoing vulnerability of critical energy infrastructure in the Middle East.

oromo: Humni tiruu (drone) buufata fiixee boba'aa biyya Saudi Arabia irratti raawwatameen miidhaan guddaan geessifamuun, dhiyeessiin boba'aa addunyaa harka afur (4%) ji'a tokkoo olif akka hir'atu ta'eera. title: Trump says he will decide if US will work towards deal with Iran
english: Donald Trump recently stated that Iran is eager to negotiate a new agreement with the United States. The former president noted that he is open to the idea of talks but emphasized that he will ultimately decide if an engagement should take place. He expressed this sentiment on his social media platform, suggesting that the pressure on Iran is driving their desire for a quick resolution.

oromo: Donald Trump akka jedhetti, Iran waliigaltee haaraa Ameerikaa waliin gochuuf fedhii guddaa qabdi. Pirezidantichi duraanii marii sana jalqabuuf fedhii qabaatus, murtoon dhumaa kan isaa ta'uu ibseera. Ibsa isaa kana miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti kan baase yoo ta'u, Iran dhiibbaa keessa waan jirtuuf ariitiin walii galuu barbaaddi jedheera.

title: French TV censors actress Adele Haenel after she condemns Israel’s genocide in Palestine
english: French actress Adele Haenel experienced censorship after publicly accusing France of supporting the genocide in Gaza during a TV interview. She further urged for international sanctions against Israel due to the ongoing situation. In response to her statements, the network removed the segment from its online replay services.
amharic: ፈረንሳዊቷ ተዋናይት አዴል ሀኔል በቴሌቪዥን ፕሮግራም ላይ ስለ ጋዛው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ከተናገረች በኋላ ሳንሱር ተደርጋለች። ሀኔል ፈረንሳይ በጋዛ ለሚፈጸመው ድርጊት ተባባሪ ናት በማለት በመወንጀል በእስራኤል ላይ ማዕቀብ እንዲጣል ጠይቃለች። ይህንን ተከትሎ የፈረንሳይ የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ ፕሮግራሙን ከኦንላይን መዝገባቸው ሰርዘውታል።
oromo: Aartistiin Faransaayi Adele Haenel, sagantaa televijiinii irratti waa'ee ajjeechaa sanyii Gaazaatti raawwatamaa jiru mormuudhaan erga dubbattee booda cinaattis dhorkamee jirti. Haenel mootummaan Faransaayi ajjeechaa kana keessatti harka qabaachuu ibsuun, Israa'el irratti tarkaanfiin adabbii akka fudhatamu gaafatteetti. Kana hordofee, dhaabbatichi sagantaa sana marsariitii isaa irraa haqee jira.

title: Minority Protection is Ethiopia’s Federal Test
english: Ethiopia must strengthen its constitutional safeguards to ensure that smaller ethnic groups are protected from political dominance by larger demographics. The national dialogue commission is encouraged to prioritize minority rights, equitable representation in federal institutions, and a more inclusive approach to national identity and symbols. Implementing these changes would help build trust among diverse communities, ensuring that the federation remains stable and fair for every citizen regardless of their background.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ አነስተኛ የብሄረሰብ ቡድኖች በአብላጫው ወገኖች የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ እንዳይደርስባቸው ህገ-መንግስታዊ ዋስትናዎቿን ማጠናከር ይኖርባታል። የሀገራዊ ምክክር ኮሚሽኑ አናሳ ብሄረሰቦች መብታቸውን እንዲከበር፣ በፌዴራል ተቋማት ውስጥ እኩል ውክልና እንዲያገኙ እና ብሄራዊ ማንነትን የበለጠ አሳታፊ በሆነ መልኩ እንዲቃኙ ይመከራል። እነዚህን ለውጦች መተግበር በተለያዩ ማህበረሰቦች መካከል መተማመንን በመገንባት፣ የፌዴራል ስርዓቱ ለሁሉም ዜጎች ፍትሃዊ እና የተረጋጋ እንዲሆን ያደርገዋል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan gareewwan xiqqoo ta'an gita duriifi dhiibbaa garee gurguddaa irraa akka eegaman sirna seera bu'uuraa ishee cimsuu qabdi. Komishiniin marii biyyoolessaa mirga garee xiqqootiif xiyyeeffannaa kennuun, dhaabbilee federaalaa keessatti bakka bu'iinsa qixxee ta'e fi mallattoolee biyyoolessaa hunda kan hammatu uumuun barbaachisaa dha. Jijjiiramoota kana hojiirra oolchuun saboota garaagaraa gidduutti amantaa uumuudhaan, federaaliizimichi lammiilee hundumaaf akka ta'uufi tasgabbii qabaatu gargaara.

title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
english: China has rejected accusations of engaging in malicious competition regarding artificial intelligence, arguing that such narratives hinder international cooperation. While US officials emphasize the need to surpass China in AI development for national security, Beijing maintains that global governance should be inclusive and transparent. Experts suggest that reaching a formal regulatory agreement between the two nations is unlikely due to their intense technological rivalry.
amharic: ቻይና በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ዘርፍ ጎጂ የሆነ ፉክክር እያደረገች ነው የሚለውን ክስ አጣጥላለች፤ እንዲህ አይነት ትርክቶች ዓለም አቀፍ ትብብርን እንደሚያደናቅፉም ገልጻለች። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ለብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሲባል በቴክኖሎጂው ከቻይና መቅደም እንደሚያስፈልግ ሲናገሩ፣ ቤጂንግ ግን ዓለም አቀፍ የቴክኖሎጂ ቁጥጥር በጋራ መርህ ላይ የተመሰረተ መሆን አለበት ትላለች። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ከፍተኛ የቴክኖሎጂ ፉክክር ለስምምነት መድረስን እንደሚያስቸግረው ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Chaayinaan damee hayyuu-maashinii ykn AI irratti dorgommii hamaa keessa jirti jedhamee himatamuu ishee waakkateetti; himannaan akkasii kunis tumsa idil-addunyaa miidha jechuun ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Ameerikaa nageenya biyya isaa tikfachuuf teeknoolojii kanaan Chaayinaa caaluu akka qabu yeroo ibsu, Chaayinaan garuu bulchiinsi teeknoolojii addunyaa waloo fi iftoomina qabaachuu qaba jetti. Dorgommiin cimaan biyyoota lamaan gidduutti jiru kun walii galtee irra ga'uun rakkisaa akka ta'e ogeeyyiin ni himu.

title: Thousands demand end to violence in Mexican cartel hotspot
english: Thousands of residents in Culiacán, Mexico, recently marched in white to protest the escalating violence caused by an internal war between rival Sinaloa cartel factions. This conflict, which has persisted for two years following a high-profile drug lord's arrest, has led to a surge in murders, disappearances, and local business closures. Organized by community leaders and religious groups, the protesters are urgently calling for an end to the fear and instability that have devastated their city.
amharic: በሜክሲኮ ኩሊያካን ከተማ የሚኖሩ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች፣ በሲናሎአ ካርቴል ቡድኖች መካከል በሚደረግ ግጭት ምክንያት እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የኃይል እርምጃ በመቃወም ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ አዘዋዋሪዎች ግጭት ላለፉት ሁለት ዓመታት ግድያዎችን፣ መጥፋቶችን እና የንግድ ተቋማት መዘጋትን በማስከተል በከተማዋ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ አሳድሯል። የሃይማኖት መሪዎች እና የሲቪል ማህበረሰብ ቡድኖች ባደራጁት በዚህ ሰልፍ፣ ነዋሪዎቹ በከተማዋ ላይ የሰፈነውን ፍርሃትና አለመረጋጋት እንዲያቆም ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Kuliyaakaan kan Meeksikoo keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman waraana garee maatiilee yakka 'Sinaloa cartel' gidduutti adeemsifamaa jiru mormuuf hiriira ba'aniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan jalqabe waggaa lama dura yommuu hogganaan yakka beekamaan tokko qabametti yoo ta'u, ajjeechaa, namoota badanii fi cufamiinsa qabeenyaa gandaa guddisuun hawaasa miidheera. Hiriirri kun kan qindeeffame garee amantii fi bakka bu'oota hawaasaatiin yoo ta'u, jiraattonni magaalaa isaanii keessatti soda fi jeequmsa jiru akka dhaabatu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Why the Houthi advance towards Yemen’s Marib, Taiz matters
english: The Houthi rebels are currently intensifying their military campaign to capture Marib and Taiz, two strategically vital regions in Yemen. Marib is particularly significant because it contains the country's primary oil and gas resources, which would grant the Houthis immense economic power and leverage. This escalation has caused a humanitarian crisis, forcing over 85,000 civilians to flee their homes to escape the ongoing violence.
amharic: የሁቲ አማጺያን በየመን የሚገኙትን ማሪብ እና ታኢዝ የተባሉ ስልታዊ ጠቀሜታ ያላቸውን አካባቢዎች ለመቆጣጠር ወታደራዊ ዘመቻቸውን አጠናክረዋል። ማሪብ የሀገሪቱ ዋና የነዳጅ እና የተፈጥሮ ጋዝ ሀብት የሚገኝበት በመሆኑ፣ አማጺያኑ ይህንን ቦታ መቆጣጠራቸው ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ አቅም ይሰጣቸዋል። ይህ የጦርነት መባባስ ከ85,000 በላይ ንጹሃን ዜጎች ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ በማድረግ ከፍተኛ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humni finxaaleyyii Huutii naannoowwan Yaman keessatti iddoo barbaachisaa ta'an kanneen akka Maarib fi Ta'iz to'achuuf duula waraanaa cimaa gaggeessaa jiru. Maarib qabeenya boba'aa fi gaasii biyyattii waan of keessaa qabduuf, to'annoo kana jalatti galchuun Huutiiwwaniif humna diinagdee guddaa kenna. Waraanni kun uumamuu isaan namoonni 85,000 ol ta'an mana isaanii gadi lakkisanii baqachuun balaa namoomaa cimaa uumeera.

title: Temporary Hormuz solution deferred as Iran-Arab summit falls through
english: A planned meeting between Iran and several Arab nations in Oman to discuss temporary navigation routes in the Strait of Hormuz has been postponed. The talks were delayed after Saudi Arabia requested changes to the proposal, raising concerns about potential impacts on regional status. Despite this setback, Iran stated it remains committed to finding a solution supported by neighboring countries while maintaining its demand for the U.S. to lift its naval blockade.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ውስጥ ጊዜያዊ የመርከብ መንገዶችን ለመወያየት በአረብ ሀገራት እና በኢራን መካከል ኦማን ውስጥ ሊካሄድ የነበረው ስብሰባ ተራዘመ። የሳውዲ አረቢያ ሀሳብ ላይ ማሻሻያዎችን መጠየቅ ለስብሰባው መራዘም ምክንያት ሆኗል፣ ይህም በክልሉ ላይ ያለውን ሁኔታ ሊቀይር ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ይህ ቢሆንም፣ ኢራን በአካባቢው ሀገራት ድጋፍ የሚደረግለትን መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን እና አሜሪካ የጣለችውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ እንድታነሳ መጠየቋን ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Hirmaattota biyyoota Arabaa fi Iran gidduutti, karaa markabaa kanneen qaxxaamura Hormuzirratti mari'achuuf guyyaa sagal dura Omaanitti qophaa'ee ture erga darbee booda yeroof dhaabateera. Saudi Arabiyaan dhiyeessii irratti jijjiirama barbaaduun ishee mariin kun akka qabamuuf sababa ta'eera. Kunis naannichatti haala jiru irratti dhiibbaa uumuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama. Ta'us, Iran biyyoota naannichaa waliin ta'uun furmaata barbaaduuf fedhii kan qabdu yoo ta'u, Ameerikaan gufuu galaanaa irratti keesse akka kaastu gaafachuu itti fufteetti.

title: Tom Aspinall vacates UFC heavyweight title due to eye injury
english: UFC heavyweight champion Tom Aspinall has officially stepped down from his title due to persistent complications from an eye injury. The injury, which occurred during a match against Ciryl Gane last year, worsened during recent training, forcing Aspinall to step away indefinitely. While he has relinquished his championship belt to allow the division to move forward, Aspinall confirmed he is not retiring and plans to return to professional fighting once he has fully recovered.
amharic: የዩኤፍሲ የከባድ ሚዛን ሻምፒዮኑ ቶም አስፒናል በአይን ጉዳት ምክንያት ከሻምፒዮንነት ማዕረጉ መልቀቁን አስታውቋል። ባለፈው ዓመት ከሲሪል ጋኔ ጋር ባደረገው ግጥሚያ የደረሰበት የአይን ጉዳት በቅርቡ በስልጠና ላይ በድጋሚ በመባባሱ ምክንያት ተዋጊው ከውድድር ለመራቅ ተገዷል። ምንም እንኳን ማዕረጉን ቢለቅም፣ አስፒናል ከስፖርቱ ጡረታ እንዳልወጣ እና ሙሉ በሙሉ ሲያገግም ወደ ቀለበት እንደሚመለስ ገልጿል።
oromo: Qondaaltotni UFC akka ibsanitti, qabsaa'aan ulfaatina guddaa Tom Aspinall miidhaa ija isaatiin walqabatee qabxii qabatee ture gadhiiseera. Miidhaan kun kan isarra ga'e waggaa darbe Ciryl Gane waliin yeroo wal-lolu yoo ta'u, amma immoo leenjii irratti dhiibbaan isaa waan itti caaleef dorgommii irraa yeroof fagaachuuf dirqameera. Aspinall qabxii isaa gadhiisuun isaa dorgommii ittifufiinsa qabu akka hin gufachiisne ibsus, kana jechuun garuu ispoortii irraa fagaachuu isaa miti; fayyummaan isaa erga deebi'ee booda gara dirree qabsoo akka deebi'u mirkaneesseera.

title: US says it’s clearing Hormuz traffic: Why are oil futures beyond $100?
english: Global oil prices have surged past $107 per barrel due to persistent concerns over shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz and damaged Saudi infrastructure. Although the US government claims to be successfully escorting vessels and restoring traffic flow, Iran disputes these assertions and has restricted access to the area. Conflicting reports between official American claims and actual shipping data indicate that the region remains highly unstable, keeping energy markets on edge.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በተፈጠረ የትራፊክ መስተጓጎል እና በሳውዲ የነዳጅ መሰረተ ልማት ላይ በደረሰ ጥቃት የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከ107 ዶላር በላይ ከፍ ብሏል። የአሜሪካ መንግስት መርከቦችን በመጠበቅ የነዳጅ እንቅስቃሴ እንዲሻሻል እያደረገ መሆኑን ቢገልጽም፣ ኢራን ይህንን በመቃወም በባህረ ሰላጤው ላይ የራሷን ገደብ ጥላለች። በአሜሪካ መግለጫዎች እና በእውነተኛው የባህር ጉዞ መረጃ መካከል ያለው ልዩነት አካባቢው አሁንም ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ችግር ውስጥ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Giddugala galaana Hormuz irratti geejjiba irratti dhiibbaa uumameefi miidhaa bu'uraalee misoomaa Sa'udii irra ga'een, gatiin boba'aa doolaara 107 irra darbeera. Mootummaan Ameerikaa dooniiwwan eeguufi yaa'insa boba'aa fooyyessaa akka jiru himus, Iraan himannaa kana mormuudhaan iddoo sana irratti daangaa kaa'atteetti. Gabaasni Ameerikaa fi ragaan qabatamaan daandii bishaanichaa irra jiru wal faallessaa waan jiraniif, nageenyi naannichaa ammas amansiisaa akka hin taane agarsiisa.

title: South Korea’s new manager Robert Moreno dismisses ‘AI coaching’ allegations
english: Robert Moreno has been appointed as the interim head coach for South Korea’s national football team following a period of poor performance and leadership instability. During his first press conference, the Spanish manager rejected rumors that he used artificial intelligence for decision-making in his previous jobs, labeling those claims as false. He is now focused on improving the team's performance for upcoming friendly matches and hopes to regain the trust of frustrated fans.
amharic: ሮበርት ሞሪኖ በደቡብ ኮሪያ ብሔራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን ውስጥ በተፈጠረ የአመራር አለመረጋጋት እና ደካማ ውጤት ምክንያት ጊዜያዊ ዋና አሰልጣኝ ሆነው ተሹመዋል። የስፔኑ አሰልጣኝ በሰጡት የመጀመሪያ ጋዜጣዊ መግለጫ፣ ቀደም ባሉ ሥራዎቻቸው ላይ ውሳኔዎችን ለመወሰን አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ተጠቅመዋል የሚለውን ወሬ ውድቅ አድርገው፣ ይህም ፍጹም ሐሰት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። አሁን ትኩረታቸውን በመጪዎቹ የወዳጅነት ጨዋታዎች ላይ በማድረግ የቡድኑን አቋም በማሻሻል የደጋፊዎችን እምነት ለመመለስ እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Robert Moreno gorsaa fi adeemsa isaa irratti rakkoo erga mudatee booda, garee kubbaa miilaa biyyoolessaa Kooriyaa Kibbaaf leenjisaa yeroo ta'ee muudameera. Leenjisichi lammii Ispeen ta'an kun walga'ii oduu isaanii isa jalqabaa irratti, hojii isaanii kanaan duraa irratti gargaarsa 'Artificial Intelligence' fayyadameera jedhamee kan odeeffamaa ture dhugaa akka hin taane ibsaniiru. Yeroo ammaa xiyyeeffannoon isaanii taphoota michummaa dhufan irratti garee isaanii fooyyessuu fi amantii fansiiwwan isaanii deebisanii argachuudha.

title: Analysis: How Algeria came to treat the UAE as a national security threat
english: Algeria recently ended its diplomatic relationship with the UAE after years of managing regional disagreements while maintaining cooperation. Tensions peaked as Algiers began viewing Emirati influence as a direct threat to its national security and sovereignty rather than just a difference in foreign policy. This shift was fueled by perceived Emirati interference in Algeria’s failed BRICS membership bid and changing dynamics in the Sahel region.
amharic: አልጄሪያ ከዓመታት የዲፕሎማሲ እና የትብብር ግንኙነት በኋላ ከዩናይትድ አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ጋር የነበራትን ግንኙነት አቋርጣለች። የአልጄሪያ መንግስት የኤሚሬቶችን ተጽዕኖ በውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ላይ ካለው ልዩነት አልፎ እንደ ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ስጋት መመልከት መጀመሩ ለዚህ ውሳኔ ምክንያት ሆኗል። በተለይም አልጄሪያ ለብሪክስ (BRICS) አባልነት ያቀረበችው ጥያቄ ውድቅ መደረግ እና በሳхеል ቀጠና ያለው የፖለቲካ ለውጥ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ቅራኔ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Aljeeriyaan waggoota dheeraaf hariiroo dippilomaasii fi waliigaltee taasisus, dhiheenya kana Gamtaa Emirate Gamtoomanii (UAE) waliin hariiroo ishee kutteetti. Mootummaan Aljeeriyaa dhiibbaa UAE taasisu dhimma siyaasaa alaa qofa osoo hin taane, nageenya biyyaa fi walabummaa isaanii irratti balaa akka ta'etti waan ilaaleef murtoo kana fudhate. Keessattuu, Aljeeriyaan miseensa garee BRICS ta'uuf yaalii goote fashaluu fi jijjiirama naannoo Saahel keessatti mul'atu irratti UAE harka qabdi jedhanii waan amananiif, walitti buutiin kunneen akka guddattu taasiseera.

title: Syria protests spread as fuel prices rise by up to 40 percent
english: Widespread protests have broken out across Syria following a government decision to raise fuel prices by up to 40 percent. Demonstrators are blocking major highways and burning tires to express their frustration with the soaring cost of living and to demand the resignation of the energy minister. The government attributes these price hikes to global supply chain disruptions and a reliance on expensive fuel imports.
amharic: ሶሪያ መንግሥት የነዳጅ ዋጋን እስከ 40 በመቶ ማሳደጉን ተከትሎ በበርካታ ከተሞች ተቃውሞዎች ተቀስቅሰዋል። ተቃዋሚዎች ዋና ዋና መንገዶችን በመዝጋት እና ጎማዎችን በማቃጠል የኑሮ ውድነቱን በመቃወም የኢነርጂ ሚኒስትሩ ስልጣን እንዲለቁ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ። መንግሥት የዋጋ ጭማሪውን ያደረገው በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት መስተጓጎል እና ከፍተኛ የውጭ ነዳጅ ጥገኝነት ምክንያት መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Soriyaa gatii boba'aa harka 40 ol guddisuusa hordofee, biyyattii keessatti mormiin cimaan ka'eera. Ummanni magaallota adda addaatti aaruun, daandiiwwan gurguddoo cufuufi konkolaataa gubuu akkasumas fedhii isaanirratti miidhaa geessisuu mormuun dhaabbata ministeera inarjii irratti hiriira ba'aniiru. Mootummaan gatii dabaluun isaa rakkoo dhiyeessii boba'aa addunyaafi biyyattiin boba'aa ala ergitu irratti hirkattuu ishee irraa kan madde ta'uu ibseera.

title: US opposes Iran nuclear chief attending IAEA conference
english: The United States has blocked the head of Iran's Atomic Energy Organization, Mohammad Eslami, from attending an annual UN nuclear agency conference in Vienna. U.S. officials stated that Eslami is currently under international sanctions and that his request for a waiver to travel for the event was rejected. Consequently, Iranian officials reported that their delegation was prevented from reaching the meeting due to these American restrictions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የኢራን የኒውክሌር ኢነርጂ ድርጅት ኃላፊ መሐመድ እስላሚ በቪየና በተዘጋጀው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የኒውክሌር ኤጀንሲ ጉባኤ ላይ እንዳይገኙ ከልክሏል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት እስላሚ ማዕቀብ የተጣለባቸው ግለሰብ በመሆናቸው ለጉዞው የጠየቁት ልዩ ፈቃድ ውድቅ መደረጉን አስታውቀዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት የኢራን ልዑካን ቡድን በአሜሪካ እንቅፋት ምክንያት ወደ ስብሰባው መድረስ እንዳልቻሉ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa hogganaa dhaabbata anniisaa niwuukilaraa Iraan, Mohammadi Islaamii, walgahii waggaa kan dhaabbata anniisaa niwuukilaraa kan mootummoota gamtoomani irratti akka hin hirmaanne dhorkeera. Ogeeyyoonni Ameerikaa akka ibsanitti, Islaamii irratti kanaan dura sagantaan adabbii waan jiruuf, hayyamni inni biyya alaatti socho'uuf gaafate fudhatama dhabeera. Kanaafuu, ergamtoonni Iraan duula Ameerikaa kanaan kan ka'e gara walgahichaa dhaquu akka hin dandeenye beekameera.

title: Can fractured pro-government forces stop the Houthi advance in Yemen?
english: Houthi forces recently launched a major military offensive in Yemen, successfully capturing the strategic city of Mocha after breaking through key government defense lines. Although various pro-government groups initially resisted the advance, they were ultimately forced to retreat toward Bab al-Mandab and Lahj. This territorial gain gives the Houthis control over a vital corridor connecting the Taiz highlands to the Red Sea coast.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ወሳኝ በሆነችው ሞቻ ከተማ ላይ መጠነ ሰፊ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር ከተማዋን መቆጣጠራቸውን ዘገባዎች አመልክተዋል። የየመን መንግሥት ደጋፊ ኃይሎች ጥቃቱን ለመመከት ቢሞክሩም በመጨረሻ ወደ ባብ አል-መንደብ እና ላሂጅ ማፈግፈግ ግድ ሆኖባቸዋል። ይህ ድል የሁቲ ኃይሎች በታኢዝ እና በቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ መካከል ያለውን ስትራቴጂያዊ መተላለፊያ እንዲቆጣጠሩ አስችሏቸዋል።
oromo: Humni Houthii biyya Yemen keessatti magaalaa baay'ee barbaachisaa taate Mochaa weeraruun to'annaa isaanii jala galchaniiru. Gareen mootummaa deggaran weerara kana dhaabuuf carraaqqii godhanis, humnoonni mootummaa gara Bab al-Mandab fi Lahjiitti duubatti akka baqatan dirqisiifamaniiru. Injifannoon kun humnoonni Houthii bakka gurguddoo fi kallattiiwwan duulaa irratti dhiibbaa akka uuman taasiseera.

title: Activists occupy British Museum over Tulchinsky’s links to Israeli settlements
english: Pro-Palestine activists recently occupied the British Museum's Great Hall to protest against ties between the institution and billionaire Igor Tulchinsky, who has financed illegal Israeli settlements. The group, known as Energy Embargo for Palestine, is also calling for the museum to sever its long-standing partnership with BP. They are demanding greater transparency and the establishment of a staff-led committee to oversee future museum sponsorships and corporate associations.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ አክቲቪስቶች በብሪቲሽ ሙዚየም ግቢ ውስጥ በመግባት ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። አክቲቪስቶቹ ሙዚየሙ በሕገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ላይ ኢንቨስት ካደረጉት ቢሊየነር ኢጎር ቱልቺንስኪ ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት እንዲያቋርጥ ጠይቀዋል። በተጨማሪም ሙዚየሙ ከቢፒ (BP) ጋር ያለውን የረጅም ጊዜ አጋርነት እንዲያቆም እና ወደፊት ለሚደረጉ የገንዘብ ድጋፎች የሰራተኞች ቁጥጥር እንዲኖር አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Duula degartoota Falasxiin kan ta'an, giddu galeessa muuziyumii Britishii keessatti hiriira mormii gaggeessaniiru. Namoonni kun, muuziyumichi biiliyooneera Igor Tulchinskii kan seeraan alaa ta'e qubannaa Israa'el gargaare waliin hariiroo qabu akka kutu gaafataniiru. Akkasumas, muuziyumichi dhaabbata boba'aa BP waliin hariiroo qabu akka dhaabu fi dhimmoota akkanaa irratti hojjattoonni muuziyumichaa murteessuu akka danda'an gaafataniiru.

title: Protests break out across Syria over fuel price increases
english: Protests have erupted across several Syrian cities following a government decision to raise fuel prices by up to 40 percent. Demonstrators blocked highways and burned tires to express their anger over the rising costs, which officials claim are necessary due to global market trends and refinery maintenance. Syria currently faces a significant fuel shortage as domestic production fails to meet the country's high daily energy demands.
amharic: የሶሪያ መንግሥት የነዳጅ ዋጋን እስከ 40 በመቶ ማሳደጉን ተከትሎ በተለያዩ የሀገሪቱ ከተሞች የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ተቀስቅሰዋል። ተቃዋሚዎች መንገዶችን በመዝጋት እና ጎማዎችን በማቃጠል የተሰማቸውን ቁጣ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ መንግሥት የዋጋ ጭማሪውን ያደረገው በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ዋጋ መናር እና በማጣሪያ ጣቢያዎች ጥገና ምክንያት እንደሆነ ገልጿል። የሶሪያ የነዳጅ ምርት የሀገሪቱን ዕለታዊ ፍላጎት ለማሟላት ባለመቻሉ ችግሩ ተባብሶ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa gatii boba'aa dhibbeentaa 40 ol guddisuu isaa hordofee, magaalota biyyattii gara garaa keessatti mormiin cimaan ka'ee jira. Namoonni mormii dhageessisan daandiiwwan gurguddoo cufuufi tayaara gubuu dhaan aarii isaanii ibsataa jiru; mootummaan immoo gatiin kun kan dabale gatiin boba'aa addunyaa dabaluufi suphaa qulqulleessituu boba'aa waan jiruuf akka ta'e ibseera. Suuriyaan oomisha boba'aa keessoo ishee gahaa waan hin qabneef, baay'ina fedhii guyyaa guyyaatiin jiru guuttachuu dadhabdee jirti.

title: Residents help battle forest fires threatening homes in Ecuadorian capital
english: In Quito, Ecuador, local residents are actively working alongside professional firefighters to combat forest fires. These dangerous blazes are currently spreading near populated residential areas. The community effort is focused on protecting homes from the advancing flames.
amharic: በኢኳዶር ዋና ከተማ ኪቶ፣ የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች በመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች ላይ አደጋ የደቀኑ የጫካ እሳቶችን ለመቆጣጠር ከእሳት አደጋ ሰራተኞች ጋር በጋራ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ። እሳቱ ወደ መኖሪያ ቤቶች እየተጠጋ በመሆኑ ህብረተሰቡ ንብረታቸውን ለመታደግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa guddoo Eekwaadoor Qitoo keessatti, jiraattonni naannichaa ibidda bosonaa giddu galeessa magaalaa fi naannoo jireenyaatti dhiyaatee jiru dhaamsuuf ogeeyyota ibidda dhaamsitoota waliin qindoominaan hojjechaa jiru. Ibidni kun manneen jireenyaa waan miidhuuf, hawaasni qabeenya isaa balaa kanarraa oolchuuf tattaaffii gochaa jira.

title: Israeli minister threatens to revoke filmmakers’ citizenship over Gaza film
english: Israeli Culture Minister Miki Zohar has threatened to strip filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor of their citizenship after their documentary about the war in Gaza won an award at the Venice Film Festival. The minister described the film, which details the use of AI in military operations, as treasonous and accused the directors of seeking validation from antisemites. The documentary, titled 'NAZA,' highlights the alleged use of an AI system to conduct mass killings, with the filmmakers publicly calling for international sanctions against Israel.
amharic: የእስራኤል የባህል ሚኒስትር ሚኪ ዞሃር፣ ስለ ጋዛ ጦርነት የሰሩት ፊልም በቬኒስ ፊልም ፌስቲቫል ሽልማት ካገኙ በኋላ፣ የፊልም ባለሙያዎቹን ዩቫል አብርሃም እና ራሄል ስዞር የዜግነት መብት እንደሚነጥቁ አስፈራሩ። ሚኒስትሩ ፊልሙን ከሃዲነት ሲሉ በመፈረጅ፣ ዳይሬክተሮቹ የአለምን ፀረ-ሴማዊያን ለማስደሰት ሲሉ በአገሪቱ ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል ብለዋል። 'ናዛ' የተሰኘው ይህ ዘጋቢ ፊልም እስራኤል ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎትን (AI) በመጠቀም በጋዛ የፈጸመችውን የጅምላ ግድያ እንደሚተርክ ይገለጻል።
oromo: Ministeerri Aadaa Israa'el Miki Zoohaar, filmii waa'ee waraana Gaazaa irratti hojjetameen booda, ogeeyyonni filmii Yuvaal Aabraaham fi Rahel Szoor lammiyummaa isaanii akka dhaban ergaa dabarsaniiru. Ministeerichi filmiin kun biyya ganuudha jechuun, darektaroonni kunneen faarfannaa namoota farra Yahuudii argachuuf jecha biyya isaanii miidhaa jiru jechuun himate. Filmiin 'NAZA' jedhamu kun, Israa'el teeknoolojii AI fayyadamuun Gaazaatti ajjeechaa faashisummaa raawwachuu ishee akka saaxile ibsameera.

title: Turkish authorities launch anti-LGBTQ raids, detaining dozens
english: Turkish police recently conducted nationwide raids targeting LGBTQ organizations, resulting in the detention of at least 63 individuals. The government claims these operations, labeled 'My Family is Safe,' aim to protect family values and address declining birth rates. However, human rights activists have condemned the crackdown as a form of state-sponsored discrimination and an attack on civil society.
amharic: የቱርክ ፖሊስ በኤልጂቢቲኪው (LGBTQ) ድርጅቶች ላይ ባደረገው መጠነ ሰፊ ዘመቻ ቢያንስ 63 ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። መንግስት 'ቤተሰቤ ደህና ነው' ብሎ የሰየመው ይህ ዘመቻ የቤተሰብ እሴቶችን ለመጠበቅ እና የወሊድ ምጣኔ መቀነስን ለመቅረፍ ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይሁን እንጂ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ድርጊቱ በመንግስት የሚደገፍ መድልዎ እና የሲቪል ማህበረሰብን የማዳከም ሙከራ ነው በማለት አውግዘውታል።
oromo: Poolisiin Turkii dhaabbilee mirga LGBTQ irratti duula biyyoolessaa geggeesseen namoota 63 ol ta'an to'annoo jala oolcheera. Mootummaan 'Maatiin koo nagaadha' jedhee kan moggaase duulli kun, duudhaa maatii fi guddina uummataa gadi bu'aa jiru hordofuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu ibseera. Haa ta'u malee, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa tarkaanfiin kun haqa dhabeessa fi mirga sivilotaa cabsuu dha jechuun balaaleffataniiru.

title: Japanese PM-backed candidate wins Okinawa gubernatorial election
english: Genta Koja, a candidate supported by Japan’s Prime Minister, has won the Okinawa gubernatorial election, defeating the incumbent Denny Tamaki. This victory is significant as it potentially ends local opposition to the relocation of a major U.S. military base within the region. As the youngest governor in Okinawa's history, Koja's win aligns with the national government's strategy to strengthen defense capabilities in response to regional tensions.
amharic: በጃፓን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር የሚደገፉት ጌንታ ኮጃ የኦኪናዋን የአስተዳዳሪ ምርጫ በማሸነፍ ነባሩን አስተዳዳሪ ዴኒ ታማኪን ተክተዋል። ይህ ድል በክልሉ ውስጥ የሚገኝ ትልቅ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ እንዲዛወር ሲደረግ የነበረውን የአካባቢው ተቃውሞ ሊያቆም የሚችል ነው። የኦኪናዋ ታሪክ ወጣት አስተዳዳሪ የሆኑት ኮጃ፣ የጃፓን መንግሥት በክልሉ ያለውን ወታደራዊ አቅም ለማጠናከር የያዘውን ዕቅድ የሚደግፉ ናቸው።
oromo: Genta Koja kan muummee ministiraa Jaappaanin deeggaramu, filannoo bulchiinsa Okinawaa moo'achuun aangoo irraa kan turan Denny Tamaki injifateera. Injifannoon kun buufata waraana Ameerikaa guddaa tokko naannichaa irraa kaasuuf mormii ture dhaabsisuu danda'a. Hogganaan Okinawaa keessatti kan umriin isaa xiqqaa ta'e kun, mootummaan biyyattii naannichatti humna waraanaa cimsuuf karoorfate akka deggaru ni eegama.

title: Protests erupt across Syria over sharp fuel price hikes
english: Widespread protests have broken out in Syria following the government's decision to significantly increase fuel prices. Officials attributed the hike, which raised diesel and gasoline costs by as much as 40%, to expensive imports and maintenance work at the Baniyas refinery. These rising costs have sparked public frustration across the country.
amharic: የሶሪያ መንግሥት የነዳጅ ዋጋን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጨመሩ ምክንያት በሀገሪቱ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ተቃውሞዎች ተቀስቅሰዋል። መንግሥት የዋጋ ጭማሪውን ያደረገው ከውጭ የሚገቡ የነዳጅ ምርቶች ዋጋ በመወደዱ እና በባኒያስ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያ እየተካሄደ ካለው ጥገና ጋር በተያያዘ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይህ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ በዜጎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ቅሬታን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa gatii boba'aa dabaluusaa hordofee, guutuu biyyattii keessatti mormiin cimaan ka'ee jira. Mootummaan gatiin boba'aa gara dhibbeentaa 40tti akka ol guddatu kan taasise, gatii gabaa idil-addunyaa irratti dabaluu fi hojii suphinsa gamoowwan gubaa boba'aa irratti xiyyeeffachuun akka ta'e ibseera. Daballii gatii kanaanis lammiileen biyyattii mormii isaanii dhageessisaa jiru.

title: Heavy rain falls over the Kaaba in Mecca
english: Severe thunderstorms and heavy rainfall recently impacted Mecca, resulting in dramatic weather conditions at the Grand Mosque. Saudi officials have issued official warnings regarding potential flooding throughout the region. Visitors and local residents are being advised to steer clear of valleys and areas prone to gathering water for their safety.
amharic: በቅርቡ በመካ ከተማ የጣለ ከባድ ዝናብ እና የመብረቅ አደጋ በግራንድ መስጂድ አካባቢ አስደናቂ ሁኔታዎችን ፈጥሯል። የሳዑዲ ባለሥልጣናት በክልሉ ሊከሰት ስለሚችል የጎርፍ አደጋ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። ነዋሪዎችና ጎብኚዎች ለደህንነታቸው ሲባል ከሸለቆዎች እና ዝቅተኛ ቦታዎች እንዲርቁ ይመከራል።
oromo: Magaalaa Makkaatti rooba cimaa fi qilleensa bubbee hordofee uumamee ture madiinaa Makkaatti argamu masjida guddaa keessatti haala adda ta'e uumeera. Abbootiin taayitaa Sa'udii bakkeewwan garagaraatti lolaan uumamuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru. Namoonni naannichaa fi daawwattoonni bakkeewwan gad-aanaa fi sululaa irraa akka fagaatan gorsa kennaniiru.

title: Charlie Kirk statue vandalised outside Turning Point USA headquarters
english: A bronze statue commemorating the late conservative activist Charlie Kirk was defaced with red paint shortly after its installation at the Turning Point USA headquarters in Phoenix. The vandals specifically targeted the statue's neck and religious symbols, which the organization described as a malicious act related to the circumstances of his 2025 shooting death. Local authorities are currently investigating the incident, and the organization has vowed to restore the memorial and pursue those responsible.
amharic: የቀኝ ዘመም አክቲቪስት የነበረው ቻርሊ ኪርክ መታሰቢያ ሐውልት በአሪዞና ፊኒክስ በሚገኘው የቱርኒንግ ፖይንት ዩኤስኤ ዋና መስሪያ ቤት አጠገብ በቀይ ቀለም ተበላሽቶ ተገኘ። ሐውልቱ ከተተከለ በጥቂት ቀናት ውስጥ በተፈጸመው በዚህ ድርጊት፣ የሐውልቱ አንገት እና ሃይማኖታዊ ምልክቶች ሆን ተብለው መጎዳታቸው ተገልጿል። የድርጅቱ አመራሮች ጉዳዩን በጽኑ ያወገዙ ሲሆን፣ ፖሊስ ወንጀለኞቹን ለመያዝ ምርመራ እየጀመረ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Siidaan yaaddannoo hooggansa mirgaa Chaarlii Kiirkii, waajjira Turning Point USA kan Finiiks, Arizonatti argamu duratti halluu diimaan xureeffamee argame. Siidichi erga dhaabbatee guyyoota muraasa booda kan miidhame yoo ta'u, vandalliin sun siidicharratti mallattoolee amantii fi mormoo isaa irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Dhaabbatichi gocha kana balaaleffatee, qaamoleen seeraa namoota yakka kana raawwatan barbaadaa akka jiran ibseera.
